Normalized snapshots omit some original tags; snapshot replay compares the same reconstructable fields under both classifiers and does not infer missing tags.

The nondiscounted 4 Hour Bike Rental Package (Includes bike and helmet) is excluded by a literal helmet match because Includes is outside the supported with/w//including split; this is not semantic primary-apparel evidence and rental handling is outside this patch.
